points.description: Names the theorem as the Maxwell-Betti reciprocal theorem (Betti's law / Maxwell's reciprocal theorem of reciprocal work/deflections), stated by name precisely.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only 'Betti's theorem' or only 'Maxwell's reciprocal theorem' is named (one of the two names, clearly the reciprocal theorem).

points.description: Identifies it explicitly as a reciprocal theorem (the term 'reciprocal' / reciprocity must be used), linking to k_ij = k_ji.

rubric.notes: Full marks only for 'Maxwell-Betti reciprocal theorem' with the term 'reciprocal' present. Naming only one of Maxwell or Betti with the reciprocal idea gets part marks on P1 only. Any other theorem (e.g., Castigliano, superposition, virtual work) or a vague answer like 'symmetry theorem' earns 0; a wrong extra theorem given as the answer voids the point.
